17. **How cities become free.** The ways a city breaks free of its master ("How cities become free"): conquered land not yet absorbed that revolts and breaks free ("Revolt follows conditions, not dice"); a governor who turns with the levies he raised, or a commander who keeps his army, and rules a city of his own, the new Idrimi; and a revolt with no one at its head raising a ruler from its own people ("A head rises where men lack one"). Each new free city is a power with a seat of its own, by the rules of item 11+. Built after item 13, since it needs governors and commanders, and after 11b's risen heads. Split from the city-states item on 21 October 2026, when city-states as powers moved forward to item 11+; a vassal who stops paying is free in practice already there. With revolt comes the gate opened from within, when a besieged city's hunger breaks its loyalty ("How long a siege lasts"). **Stop for review.**
